value.rationale: Determines exact capacities for Dyck-language codewords through twelve transmitted bits and the first strict objective gap between fractional packing and integral packing for the cardinality objective. This differs from the onset of polyhedral nonintegrality: the semilength-four example in RESULT.md has a fractional vertex despite equality of the two optimal values. The objective gap and exact capacities are benchmarks for constrained-source design and relaxations.
